approval.review_body_sha256_method: sha256 of the body bytes that the GitHub API returns for the approving review

accepted_scope.guarantee: After the owner stop at the end of each segment, host-control stop-under stops every same-user process whose arguments or working directory are under .subprocess-data, records each one in residual-writers.txt, and fails the segment with writer_stop_failed when a writer survives or the tree keeps changing during the quiet window.
limitations: A same-user process that names a path under .subprocess-data in its arguments is stopped, also when it is not a soak writer.
An uninspected writer that writes less often than once in 2 s can pass the write check.
After a host protection breach, the residual stop skips the write check.
accepted_scope.excluded: Node correctness, the profile claims, the cause of the missed owner match, and a live soak result.

claim_digests_note: The claim document adds the acceptance sentence of 2026-10-23 to the section that the review package records.
